task.description: Make T5 RED tests green by introducing the shared pair render/write owner used by init/update/rules sync/distill. Preserve module/security/user flags, short index and full routing; pair failure must be observable and rerun recoverable. Update affected orient/catalog consumers and tests honestly; preserve public APIs. Read task input T7-input.json.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: M01: init, rules sync, rules distill, update and repeated sequences preserve a short index plus full routing document through a shared writer; enabled module/security flags and user-owned entrypoint blocks are preserved.

AC2: M01: orient/catalog and related consumers resolve the split entrypoint, regression fixtures assert correct ownership of both documents, failed pair publication is observable and recoverable on rerun without a false success.
task.module_patterns: Reuse existing pure renderers and node fs atomic writers; Bun black-box temp-root tests. Scope preserves model-independent routing semantics.
